description:
Local memory and context for you and your AI agent: Markdown notes, documents and tasks on your disk, with an MCP server for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
Tisty 1.48.0
You see the whole, your agent every detail: write on the page you read, a Diary that is only yours, and reminders even with Tisty closed
- Tisty is now told as the working memory you share with your AI agent: you see the whole and decide, your agent works the detail, and nothing closes without you.
- The welcome guide opens with why Tisty exists and how you and your agent split the work, and the part on your agent comes right after how Tisty works.
- You write on the very page you read: no editing mode and no block to open, and the page looks the same while you write as when you read, print or share it.
- Choose a few words and a bar comes up with bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, a link and four pens; the / or the + in the margin inserts the rest.
- Each block has a handle to drag it, duplicate it or delete it, and Esc chooses the whole block.
- Undo takes back what you typed in a row, not key by key, and copying takes the Markdown of what you chose.
- A task's page is written the same way, and Sections lets you add, rename or take off its sections.
- Long pages answer much faster while you write, lists stay lists, and an audio or video keeps playing while you write beside it.
- A Diary for what happened today: it always opens on today, keeps a book a year with a page a month, and shows the tasks you finished that day.
- A click on a day's words opens it to write, and a note's × asks before it goes.
- You write in it from anywhere: in the quick capture, Tab goes from a task to an idea to today's diary.
- The Diary is only yours: no AI agent sees it until you open it, and it is never shared by link.
- A reminder rings at its hour even with Tisty closed, and a click on it opens its task; an important one can come through Do not disturb.
- Save to my calendar takes a task with a date to Google Calendar, to Outlook or, on a Mac, to Apple Calendar, so your phone reminds you too.
- Ctrl + P takes you to any document, task or folder as you type its name, and with > it shows the window's actions.
- A weekly review gathers what waits to be decided, the documents your agent marked as past and the ones you have not opened in 60 days, and can remind you every week.
- The Library brings back documents you have not opened in a while, and opens one at random.
- A document can open read only in a window of its own beside your work.
- Empty views offer an example you write with one click.
- Settings, About and the help tell Tisty as the memory you share with your agent, free under the AGPL-3.0.
